Product.title: Natraj Aluform
Product.description:

Ensuring the highest level of purity and quality in our billets is paramount. That’s why we utilize industry-leading technologies such as ALSCAN and PoDFA (Porous Disc Filtration Analysis) to assess the purity of the aluminum during the casting process. These technologies enable us to detect and mitigate impurities, ensuring that every billet meets the highest metallurgical standards.

Product.title: Natraj Aluform
Product.slug: The Foundation of High-Quality Extrusion Billets
Product.description: An aluminium extrusion plant uses a melting furnace to convert aluminium ingots, billets, and approved scrap into molten aluminium. The furnace operates at a controlled temperature, typically around 700–760°C, depending on the alloy and process requirements. During melting, the material is carefully monitored to control temperature, chemical composition, hydrogen content, and impurities. Fluxing and proper skimming help remove unwanted oxides and inclusions from the molten metal. The molten aluminium is then transferred to the casting unit, where it is solidified into billets suitable for the extrusion process. Proper furnace operation is essential for producing billets with consistent quality, strength, surface finish, and extrusion performance.
